$comment: Cover sheet for an imported Declarative Watch Face Format (<WatchFace>) sample from unmodified upstream android/wear-os-samples. The codeless watch-face module declares res/raw/watchface.xml, which compose-preview discovers as preview `watchface` and renders through the DWF RemoteCompose lane with structured complication and user-configuration metadata in previews/<id>.watchface.json.
title: Wear OS Watch Face: Complications

completeness.$comment: Declarative Watch Face Format XML resources render through the DWF RemoteCompose lane and have no Compose UI semantics tree; their structured inspection surface is previews/<id>.watchface.json.

components.caption: Analog watch face with five customizable complication slots (SHORT_TEXT, RANGED_VALUE, MONOCHROMATIC_IMAGE, SMALL_IMAGE, GOAL_PROGRESS, WEIGHTED_ELEMENTS) and a color style configuration.
